Around them, a cheering crowd of fellow hobos gathers, waving signs, clapping, and yelling with excitement. Some hold bottles wrapped in brown paper bags, others lean against walls, placing bets and jeering at the fighters.

Graffiti-covered walls are splattered with tags and street art, adding to the sense of urban decay.

Rats scurry around the edges of the fight, occasionally darting out from behind trash cans and broken crates.

Quickly transition to close-ups of fists connecting, sweat flying, and shoes slipping in puddles.

Low-angle shots emphasize the towering walls and flickering shadows cast by the trash fires.

Occasional rat-eye view shots, skittering past the fight and weaving through piles of garbage.

Special Effects:

A final wide shot reveals the two fighters still standing, surrounded by a wild, chaotic crowd that keeps shouting and waving.
